description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy across different conditions, with accuracy plotted on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale and initial confidence plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 in linear scale. The plot displays three distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers, a dashed orange line with diamond markers, and a dashed green line with square markers. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.90 when initial confidence is 0.91, remains near 1.0 across the range, and ends at approximately 1.0 when initial confidence is 0.98. The orange line begins at approximately 0.60 at initial confidence 0.91, rises to a peak of approximately 0.90 at initial confidence 0.92, then steadily declines to approximately 0.10 at initial confidence 0.98. The green line starts at approximately 0.20 at initial confidence 0.91, dips to approximately 0.05 at initial confidence 0.92, then steadily increases to approximately 0.90 at initial confidence 0.98. All lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
